purpose: Composable toolkit for creating command-line interfaces in Python with minimal code and sensible defaults.

components.name: Core Engine
components.responsibility: Manages CLI execution contexts, command hierarchies, parameter evaluation, and command execution flow.

components.name: CLI Decorators
components.responsibility: Provides user-facing decorators for defining commands, groups, options, arguments, and context bindings.

components.name: Argument Parser
components.responsibility: Parses raw CLI command-line argument lists into structured option and argument values.

components.name: Parameter Types
components.responsibility: Converts and validates command-line input strings into custom or built-in Python data types.

components.name: Terminal UI & Utilities
components.responsibility: Handles interactive prompts, progress bars, ANSI text styling, pagers, and platform stream compatibility.

components.name: Help Formatter
components.responsibility: Formats CLI usage documentation, option tables, and text wrapping for terminal displays.

components.name: Shell Completion
components.responsibility: Generates completion scripts and dynamically resolves completion items for supported shells.

components.name: Test Runner
components.responsibility: Provides isolated test environments and standard I/O redirection to test CLI applications.

edges.what: Instantiates Command and Group objects from decorated functions
Passes raw string arguments for token parsing
Delegates parsed string values for type conversion and validation
Supplies command parameters and metadata to generate formatted help text
Navigates command trees and contexts to return completion suggestions
Invokes CLI command hierarchies with mocked arguments and I/O streams
